details: Bitcoin fell below $78,000 on May 16, triggering over $580 million in liquidations, largely from leveraged long positions, across the crypto market. This downturn is linked to a global bond market sell-off, higher-than-expected inflation data (PPI 6% above forecast), and increasing oil prices, diminishing prospects for Federal Reserve rate cuts.
title: Crypto Market Sees $580M Liquidations as Bitcoin Dips Below $78K

details: The US Senate Banking Committee approved the CLARITY Act (Digital Asset Market Clarity Act of 2025) with a 15-9 vote. This landmark bill seeks to create a comprehensive federal regulatory framework for the digital asset market, addressing anti-money laundering, sanctions, and crypto kiosk regulations, aiming to bring clarity to the industry.
title: US Senate Committee Advances CLARITY Act for Crypto Regulation

details: Ethereum is advancing its Clear Signing standard to improve wallet security, especially against risks posed by AI agents. This initiative aims to give users a clearer understanding of transaction details before signing, mitigating the dangers of misleading signatures or compromised instructions from AI systems.
title: Ethereum Develops 'Clear Signing' Standard for Enhanced Wallet Security

details: THORChain has confirmed a $10 million loss resulting from a node vulnerability, leading to a temporary halt in global trading. The decentralized exchange protocol has initiated efforts to recover the lost funds.
title: THORChain Suffers $10M Loss from Node Vulnerability, Pauses Trading

details: Crypto mining firm Bit Digital announced a $146 million loss in Q1. Despite this, the company is increasing its Ethereum holdings, with its treasury now exceeding 155,000 ETH, while also venturing into artificial intelligence investments.
title: Bit Digital Reports Q1 Loss, Expands Ethereum & AI Investments

details: JPMorgan has announced the launch of a new tokenized money market fund, built on the Ethereum blockchain. This move signifies increasing institutional adoption and integration of traditional finance with decentralized ledger technology.
title: JPMorgan Launches Tokenized Money Market Fund on Ethereum
